consequence.statement: Only the CLI error message shown when updating a cluster that is not present is corrected; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: The Argo CD CLI now logs the correct error message when updating a cluster that is not present.

decision.reason: [ev-8705de7af359] is a changelog bug-fix line that says only that the CLI now logs the correct error message when someone updates a cluster that is not present. That operation already fails either way, so only the message wording changes. The evidence names nothing that fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, so kind "none" (informational, low severity) fits. Calling it behavior-change, as P1 does, would overstate a correction to diagnostic text.
